label: late-episode clock (trials ~85-99), mainly at D1
explanation: An episode-time unit. It never fires before episode trial ~60 and is active on 38% of steps in trials 90-99 (89% of activation mass there, 10% in trials 80-89). 90% of the mass is at D1 and about 10% at D2; it is almost never active at GO, except on rare D1 fixation-break trials. Magnitude rises steadily through the last trials of the episode, with the top activations in the final few trials. Within that late window it is stronger at D1 when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1: 67% of mass), and somewhat stronger when the agent is choosing a2/S2. It is strongly linked to a low value-head output (value < 5.22 holds 93% of the mass), which fits the value falling as the episode end nears. It does not track the trial pattern (common/rare x reward), stay/switch, or the good state. The predicate (D1 at ep_trial >= 87, or D2 at ep_trial >= 94) uses only observed time; it gets dev F1 0.74 with mass recall 0.95. Misses are weak early-onset activations (trials 60-86), and false positives are late D1/D2 steps where the unit stays below threshold, mostly after unrewarded trials. Because the activation is graded rather than a clean on/off, I call it partial.
